Input image: Image 1 is appearance-only guidance for broad visible adult facial and hair traits; biometric identity is not evaluated or claimed.

Create a photorealistic, physically built 1960s science-magazine still of a vivid atompunk isotope orchard inside a decommissioned 1962 reactor greenhouse. Show one unmistakably adult woman, using the supplied portrait solely as appearance guidance for her long wavy dark hair, gently oval face, warm brown eyes, natural straight-to-softly-arched brows, and softly defined coral lips. The night-shift horticulturist is calibrating a chrome seed-vault as cobalt-glass fruit pulses among waist-high hydroponic vines, her fingers visibly pressing one Bakelite control while a compact analog robot offers a glowing specimen in articulated tongs. Bold 1965 curves shape a civilian rocket-service gantry around readable power meters, visibly pairing space-age optimism with reactor risk. Cream-and-turquoise enamel panels, analog radiation gauges, finned aluminum housings, orbiting-electron motifs, and condensed glass growing tubes span the architecture and machinery. Her practical silver lamé coverall and clear acrylic dosimeter, plus a hanging bubble helmet, complete the work gear. A shielded power umbilical links vault and floor socket through exposed connectors, twin analog load gauges, and a clear dosimetry window. An open shielded diagnostic drawer displays a cobalt sample beneath a needle detector and paired dose-versus-load dials. A worn turquoise service cart carries a coiled replacement sensor, scuffed shield collar, and tagged spent umbilical in its return tray. Use a wider, lower layered environmental frame. One clear spatial sweep fully exposes condensation-beaded vertical glass growing tubes, the complete civilian rocket-service gantry beyond them, and the entire shielded umbilical path from the vault connector bank to a finned floor socket; its twin load gauges and clear dosimetry window occupy a separate panel from the diagnostic drawer gauges. Keep face, both hands, vault, robot, helmet, vines, drawer, service cart, and every candidate prop simultaneously legible. Shared warm fixtures and cobalt glow create coherent reflections, condensation, material wear, and contact shadows.

Avoid: over-processed retouching, illustration look, cartoon style, excessive HDR, fake-looking background, low resolution, 3D render look
